title: fix(components): the phone navigation drawer announces its name in the session's language
body:
Fixes #37018

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:手机上打开导航抽屉时,读屏软件播报的名称改为当前语言(中文为「应用导航」),不再固定念英文;屏幕上看到的内容不变。
- 为什么做:属于界面无障碍与多语言体验,替使用读屏软件的非英文用户解决播报语言不一致的问题。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是抽屉名称播报回英文或缺失,只影响读屏播报,不影响点击与导航,可直接撤回本改动。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

- New `ui/packages/components/src/lib/sidebar-drawer-label.tsx`: `SidebarDrawerTitle` renders `console.nav.menuLabel` through `createSafeTranslation`, with the English fallback "App navigation" when no I18nProvider is mounted. It is not exported from the package index. The key already exists in all twelve locale packs (zh-Hans 应用导航), and the app menu inside the drawer already uses it as its own name.
- New `LOCAL_PATCHES.sidebar` family `sidebar-drawer-label-*` (issue objectstack#37018) in `ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`, with three patches whose anchors come from `sidebar.registry.txt` after `rewriteRegistryImports`. The patches import the title and drop `SheetDescription` from the sheet import, add `aria-describedby={undefined}` on the mobile SheetContent, and replace the English SheetTitle/SheetDescription pair with a SheetTitle that wraps `SidebarDrawerTitle`.
- `ui/packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx`: only the lines the patch engine produces. They were written by running `applyLocalPatches('sidebar', …)` on the shipped file, and that run applied exactly the three new patches.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts`: declares the new family and widens the "no patch outside these families" set to five. This test is the shared harness for the patch families, and its family-closure pin goes red without this edit.
- No locale-pack key, no new export or exported prop.

## Tests

- `packages/components/src/__tests__/sidebar-drawer-label-37018.test.tsx`, three cases. Under zh-Hans the dialog name is 应用导航 and the English title and description are gone. Under en, and with no provider, the name is "App navigation". The drawer opens with no Radix missing-description or missing-title console notice.
- Reverse check on the title swap (fix committed, mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): all three cases go red, and the restore shows the file hash equal to HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`.
- Reading on the description: the `@radix-ui/react-dialog` 1.1.23 this package resolves has no missing-description warning, and it already leaves `aria-describedby` off when no Description is mounted. Removing `aria-describedby={undefined}` kept all three cases green. The prop follows the tree's convention (six other DialogContent sites use it), and the no-warning case guards a future Radix that brings the warning back.

## Acceptance notes

- Name key choice: `console.nav.menuLabel` over `appDesigner.navigation` ("Navigation"), whose only consumer is the App Creation Wizard's step label, which means something else.

## Verification

Two-minute check: from `ui/`, run `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/sidebar-drawer-label-37018.test.tsx`. Expect three passing cases, and the zh-Hans case finds a dialog named 应用导航.

Read first: (1) the `sidebarDrawerLabelPatches` block in `ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`, where the anchors must match registry bytes; (2) the mobile branch of `Sidebar` in `sidebar.tsx`; (3) `sidebar-drawer-label.tsx`.

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: Test Files 172 passed, 2 skipped (174); Tests 5131 passed, 2 skipped. Lock verdict command-exit 0.
- New test plus `sidebar-cookie-restore` plus the shadcn-local-patches test: the patches test was red before its family pin and green after (see Tests).
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/components`: Tasks 49 successful. Lock verdict command-exit 0.
- Derived families (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 40 entries): 38 exit 0. `check:type-check-debt` exited 3 on the first run and its re-run was still waiting on the shared verify lock when this was written. The `ui/scripts` vitest entry is the run above.
